title: 8 - Music Hill - The Music City Collection
description:
Located in the heart of one of Nashville's hottest areas known as "Music Hill". No detail spared in this like new 4 bedroom/3.5  bathroom designer home that has been thoughtfully curated for a luxury guest experience.  Each Bedroom has a Plush King size bed.  Minutes to Downtown Broadway, The Gulch, and walkable to Melrose and Berry Hill attractions, this is an AMAZING LOCATION regardless of what you've come to town for.

STRP#2025-12-01-690

The space
This is a three level townhome with rooftop deck.  The first level includes the attached garage, kitchen, dining, and living room. On the second level you have the primary bedroom with ensuite bath, laundry room, and another bedroom with ensuite bath.  The third level includes the bonus room and rooftop patio with fireplace, as well as two additional bedrooms and a hall bath.  All bedrooms have king size beds.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire private home and attached two-car garage that can fit two small or mid-size vehicles.  One additional dedicated parking space is available behind the home.
